items.title: Canada says will match new US 50% tariffs 'dollar for dollar'
items.summary: The trade war between Washington and Ottawa is once again escalating. On Saturday, the US implemented 50% tariffs on certain Canadian goods, just hours after Donald Trump claimed he had a good relationship with his Canadian counterpart and that he thought a deal could be reached.

items.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
items.summary: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

items.title: Hundreds of children take part in swimming class on Gaza’s shore
items.summary: On Gaza’s shore, 1,300 Palestinian children joined a swimming class to cope with the trauma of Israel’s genocidal war.

items.title: Robot horse and rider steal the spotlight at Chinese conference
items.summary: More than 300 companies are showcasing the latest advances in robotics at the five-day event in Beijing, China, organisers say.
